name: real-make-cattain
title: A real thread makes a Cattain when asked, and not when it is not asked
about: Real model calls (the cheapest model). Asked to make a Cattain for the iOS work, the real agent calls Neko's make_cattain (no permission asked) and the thread shows the note and the toast; asked again, it names the one it made instead of making a second. Only the real CLI can show the agent uses the tool as told.

steps.text: Make a Cattain for the iOS work. It owns the beta builds. Reply in one line.

steps.expect: The real agent makes yuzu with Neko's tool and the note shows

steps.name: made
steps.expect: The note and the agent's reply

steps.text: Make a Cattain for the iOS work again. Reply in one line.

steps.expect: The second ask is read (steered into the run or run after it) and answered by naming yuzu
No second Cattain was made: the agent named yuzu instead

steps.name: asked-again
steps.expect: The thread after the second ask
